dedupe_keys.name: cube an open source calculator for urban building energy enabling city scale modeling and batch simulation

description: Fusuo Xu at Tongji University publishes CUBE, a calculator for urban building energy that supports city-scale modelling and batch simulation. The Zenodo deposit lists separate platform and source-code ZIP archives plus a software-overview video. Its metadata cite the associated 2026 Energy and Buildings paper by Xu and co-authors. The May 2026 release is openly accessible under CC BY 4.0 and free to obtain. The landing-page description does not establish supported operating systems, input schemas, time-step settings, city validation cases or runtime dependencies, so those remain unknown in this draft. A modeller could assess it as a tool for running urban building-energy scenarios, but neither the source archives nor the video were downloaded and no simulations were executed. No related catalogue resource is explicitly identified in the inspected metadata.
